from typing import List
class Solution:
    def addToArrayForm(self, num: List[int], k: int) -> List[int]:
        # FIX: the previous version did int(''.join(map(str,num))) + k, which
        # raises ValueError on CPython >= 3.11 when num has more than 4300
        # digits (int<->str conversion limit) -> Runtime Error. Add manually.
        res = []
        i = len(num) - 1
        carry = k
        while i >= 0 or carry:
            if i >= 0:
                carry += num[i]
                i -= 1
            res.append(carry % 10)
            carry //= 10
        return res[::-1]

class Solution:
    def maxPower(self, s: str) -> int:
        # FIX: the bank entry had the driver name of LeetCode 2414
        # (longestContinuousSubstring, ord(c) == ord(prev) + 1) under the
        # 1446 slug -> Runtime Error (AttributeError). 1446 wants maxPower
        # and counts runs of the SAME character.
        best = cur = 0
        for i, ch in enumerate(s):
            cur = cur + 1 if i and ch == s[i - 1] else 1
            best = max(best, cur)
        return best
